metadata.parameter_flattening: jax.flatten_util.ravel_pytree; tree_flatten order, C-order per leaf

grid.flattening: C-order meshgrid(xs, ts); x varies fastest

blas.name: scipy-openblas
blas.openblas configuration: OpenBLAS 0.3.31.188.0  USE64BITINT DYNAMIC_ARCH NO_AFFINITY SkylakeX MAX_THREADS=64

lapack.name: scipy-openblas
lapack.openblas configuration: OpenBLAS 0.3.31.188.0  USE64BITINT DYNAMIC_ARCH NO_AFFINITY SkylakeX MAX_THREADS=64

conventions.jacobian: J has shape (N,P); J.T = Q R
conventions.packed_qr: P-by-N, Fortran contiguous; R above/on diagonal, Householder vectors below; tau stores reflector coefficients; use mmap_mode='c' when applying dormqr (temporary LAPACK writes)
conventions.svd: R = svd_U @ diag(singular) @ svd_Vt; U and Vt have shape (N,N)
conventions.singular_order: descending, untruncated; QR complement is structural, not the entire kernel when J is rank deficient
conventions.grid_modal_tangents: N-by-M, Fortran contiguous; column j = U.T @ (Q.T g_j)[:N]
conventions.gradient_samples: K-by-P gradients, linked to grid columns by integer gradient_sample_indices
conventions.grid_scope: Only the supplied existing evaluation grid; new points require new gradients

reload_checks.interpretation: Reload/layout consistency; not a weak-mode forward-error certificate.
